security_spec.violation_condition: When the instruction decoder or LSU execution path for AMO instructions (opcode=0101111) does not recognize funct3=000 (byte) and funct3=001 (halfword) combined with funct5=00010 (LR) or funct5=00011 (SC), or when the LR load datapath sign-extends based on a stale width assumption (e.g., always word/doubleword) instead of the actual subword access size specified by funct3, causing LR.B/LR.H results to be zero-extended or truncated rather than sign-extended per spec.
security_spec.summary: LR.B/LR.H sign-extension bug: AMO LR datapath may not sign-extend byte/halfword loads, corrupting CHERI capability bounds when subword atomics are used
